summary: Completed comprehensive testing of User CRUD operations (edit, password reset, delete) and Ticket delete functionality. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly including user edit/delete/password reset buttons and ticket delete buttons.

issues: Minor console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: User CRUD endpoints properly implemented with admin role checks
PATCH /api/users/{id} - Updates user full_name, email, role with proper validation
POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password - Password reset with minimum 6 character validation
DELETE /api/users/{id} - Admin-only deletion with self-deletion prevention
DELETE /api/tickets/{id} - Deletes ticket and all related data (comments, history, attachments)
Non-admin users can only update their own profile and reset their own password
Email uniqueness check prevents duplicate emails on update
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed users and tickets during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: User CRUD and Ticket Delete features fully tested and working. Permission tests verify non-admin users cannot modify other users but can modify their own profile. Frontend tests verified: User list page with edit/delete/password reset buttons, edit dialog with form fields, password reset dialog with generate button, ticket list page with view/delete buttons.
